arabic text:
Koi bhi zaire shabbir jab bhi sham jaata hai
Diya qabr e Sakina par Wo jaise hi jalata hai
Usse shabbir ki dukhtar ka ye noha rulata hai
Mere zair tera maqbool ho zindan tak aana
Mera ik kaam kardena ke jab tum karbala jana
Mere baba se ye kehna
Sakina yaad karti hai
english translation text:
Whenever a pilgrim of Imam Hussain goes to Shaam,
and lights a lamp at the grave of little Sakina,
he feels her sorrow and begins to cry.
Sakina says: “May your ziyarat be accepted,
come even to my prison.
And when you go to Karbala, tell my Baba that
Sakina remembers him.

arabic text:
Tera chehra tera seena
Sakina yaad karti hai
Mere baba se ye kehna
Sakina yaad karti hai
english translation text:
His face and his chest —
Sakina remembers them.
Tell my Baba that
Sakina remembers him.

arabic text:
Mere baba se kehna ke tumhare baad aye baba
Kisi ne piyar se mujhko kabhi beti nahi bola
Tera chahat bhara lehja
Sakina yaad karti hai
english translation text:
Tell him that after he left,
no one lovingly called me ‘daughter.’
His gentle voice —
Sakina remembers it.

arabic text:
Unhe kehna Sakina soo nahi payi kabhi baba
Bichona khak hai us par badan zakhmi yateema ka
Sulana piyar se tera
Sakina yaad karti hai
english translation text:
Tell him Sakina never slept again.
Her bed is dust, her wounded orphaned body lies on the ground.
The way he put me to sleep —
Sakina remembers it.

arabic text:
Balaa ka khof hai baba mere is aashiyane me
Bohot ghabra rahi hun me andhere qaid khane me
Ujala teri aankho ka
Sakina yaad karti hai
english translation text:
There is great fear in this dark prison.
I am very scared in this lonely cell.
The light of his eyes —
Sakina remembers it.

arabic text:
Me laasho se ulaj kar gir rahi thi neend ke maare
Kate sar se sar e maqtal mere baba mere piyare
Ilaiyya wo tera kehna
Sakina yaad karti hai
english translation text:
I stumbled over bodies, sleepy and weak,
and fell near the severed heads in the battlefield.
His comforting words —
Sakina remembers them.

arabic text:
Mujhe darbar me zaalim ye kehta tha sadain de
Agar tujh se mohabbat hai to tere pass ye aaye
Tera sar tasht se uthna
Sakina yaad karti hai
english translation text:
In the tyrant’s court he mocked me,
telling me to call my father.
When his blessed head rose from the tray —
Sakina remembers it.

arabic text:
Jahan tum or me rehte the kiya acha gharana tha
Nahi tha shimr ka dar naa tamacha, taaziyana tha
Madina wo watan apna
Sakina yaad karti hai
english translation text:
The home where we lived was peaceful.
There was no Shimr, no slaps, no whips.
Our Madina —
Sakina remembers it.

arabic text:
Tera naad e Ali parh kar mujhe kehna meri beti
Dua hai tere baba ki kabhi naa tu rahe piyasi
Teri hasrat ko aye baba
Sakina yaad karti hai
english translation text:
When he recites Nad‑e‑Ali,
tell him to call me “my daughter,” and pray that I never thirst.
His prayers —
Sakina remembers them.

arabic text:
Sakina ne kaha Yasir mere baba se ye kehna
Yaqeen hai mere baba yaad karte ho mujhe utna
Tumhe zindaan se jitna
Sakina yaad karti hai
english translation text:
Sakina told Yasir: “Tell my Baba this —
I know he remembers me, but not as much
as Sakina remembers him
from inside the prison.”
